summary.tldr: Appropriates $11.2 billion for federal public administration in 2024-25 and takes effect on Royal Assent.
what_it_does: Appropriates $11,187,495,220 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2025.
Covers federal public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for.
Takes effect when it receives Royal Assent.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 13 June 2024 and received Royal Assent on 20 June 2024.
